event_var.var_meaning: likely event-free survival event indicator: 1 = event, 0 = censored

notes: EFS is explicitly defined in the paper as time from diagnosis to first episode of relapse, progression, death, or secondary malignancy; patients without an event were censored at the date of last contact.
The GSM metadata explicitly contain 'efstime' and 'efscens'.

The time unit is not explicitly stated in the metadata or paper, so var_unit is set to 'unknown'; values are consistent with days because 'age at_diag' and 'age at_first_event_or_censor' appear to be recorded in days and their differences match 'efstime' approximately.

Coding for 'efscens' is not explicitly documented; it is inferred from the paper definition and sample patterns (e.g., GSM6751298 has 'efstime: 148', 'stime: 3216', 'efscens: 1', 'scens: 0', consistent with an EFS event but no OS death).
Although the field name contains 'cens', observed values are most consistent with 1 meaning an EFS event occurred and 0 meaning censored for EFS.

event_var.var_meaning: likely overall survival event indicator: 1 = death, 0 = censored/alive

notes: OS is explicitly defined in the paper as time from diagnosis to death; surviving patients were censored at the date of last contact.
The GSM metadata explicitly contain 'stime' and 'scens'.
The time unit is not explicitly stated in the metadata or paper, so var_unit is set to 'unknown'; values are consistent with days from diagnosis.

Coding for 'scens' is not explicitly documented; it is inferred from the paper definition and sample patterns (e.g., GSM6751298 has longer 'stime' than 'efstime' and 'scens: 0', consistent with being alive/censored after an earlier EFS event; GSM6751294 has 'scens: 1' with shorter survival time than long-follow-up censored cases, consistent with death).
Although the field name contains 'cens', observed values are most consistent with 1 meaning OS event (death) and 0 meaning censored/alive.
